# Comparison semantics, original result values, propagation and short-circuiting:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/conditional_expressions.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/collation-concepts.md

SELECT CASE COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci') WHEN 'foo' THEN 'Matched' ELSE 'Different' END
=> "Matched"

SELECT CASE 'Foo' WHEN COLLATE('foo', 'und:ci') THEN 'Matched' ELSE 'Different' END
=> "Matched"

SELECT CASE COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci') WHEN 'bar' THEN 'Matched' ELSE 'Original' END
=> "Original"

SELECT CASE COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci') WHEN 'foo' THEN 'First' WHEN 'FOO' THEN ERROR('unselected') ELSE ERROR('unselected') END
=> "First"

SELECT CASE COLLATE(NULL, 'und:ci') WHEN NULL THEN 'Matched' ELSE 'Null is not equal' END
=> "Null is not equal"

SELECT CASE COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci') WHEN 'foo' THEN 42 ELSE 0 END
=> "42"

# Result annotations are independent of the collation used to compare the input.
SELECT (CASE COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci') WHEN 'foo' THEN 'Result' ELSE 'Other' END) = 'result'
=> "false"

SELECT (CASE COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci') WHEN 'foo' THEN COLLATE('Result', 'und:ci') ELSE 'Other' END) = 'result'
=> "true"

SELECT CASE 'Foo' WHEN 'foo' THEN COLLATE('Matched', 'und:ci') ELSE 'Different' END
=> "Different"

SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), 'foo')
=> null

SELECT NULLIF('Foo', COLLATE('foo', 'und:ci'))
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), 'bar')
=> "Foo"

SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), NULL)
=> "Foo"

SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE(NULL, 'und:ci'), 'foo')
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE('', 'und:ci'), '')
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), 'bar') = 'foo'
=> "true"

SELECT NULLIF('Foo', 'foo')
=> "Foo"

# Canonically equivalent Unicode strings compare equal, not just ASCII case variants.
SELECT NULLIF(COLLATE('å', 'und:ci'), 'Å')
=> null

SELECT CASE COLLATE('å', 'und:ci') WHEN 'Å' THEN 'Equivalent' ELSE 'Different' END
=> "Equivalent"

# Compare row-dependent inputs and retain their original spelling.
SELECT STRING_AGG(NULLIF(w, 'FOO'), ',' ORDER BY w) FROM UNNEST([COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), 'Bar', 'Zed']) AS w
=> "Bar,Zed"
